latestVersion.changelog:
Editorial-review v1.0.0 introduces a comprehensive editorial review process for Chinese content before publication.

- Provides multi-layered checks: character accuracy, punctuation/typography, grammar/logic, factual correctness, and political/compliance issues.
- Supports various content types: articles, news, blogs, marketing, social media, and more.
- Matches industry “Three Reviews, Three Proofs” standards, adapting them into a structured, AI-supported review pipeline.
- Offers selectable review modes (Quick, Standard, Deep) based on content length and stakes.
- Generates detailed reports locating, categorizing, and fixing all identified issues for Chinese-language materials.
- Ensures compliance with Chinese laws and publishing requirements, including political sensitivity and advertising regulations.
